# Lane: examples/github/generated is regenerated by the build, and checked by CI

Read /tmp/claude/graph_weaver/brief-common.md first (gate, commit rules, traps), then
CLAUDE.md's "Code the build doesn't exercise rots silently" gotcha — this lane closes
one instance of it.

## The problem

`examples/github/generated/*.rb` is checked in, generated from the real GitHub
schema by `examples/github/generate.rb` (which needs `gh auth token` or
`GITHUB_TOKEN`, and caches the introspection at the gitignored
`examples/github/schema.json`). Nothing regenerates it and no spec reads it, so it
drifted two releases before a scribe noticed; today it carries the 0.7.4 header
while everything under `spec/generated` says 0.7.5 (the release commit's
`bin/generate` doesn't reach it).

## The rule to land

"`bin/generate` regenerates every checked-in generated file, and the integration
workflow fails when one is stale." Concretely:

1. `bin/generate` also regenerates `examples/github/generated` **when the cached
   dump `examples/github/schema.json` is present** (a dev box that has run the
   example once), reusing `examples/github/setup.rb`'s graph declaration rather than
   restating it — refactor `generate.rb` so both doors call one function. When the
   dump is absent it prints one line saying the example was skipped and why, and
   exits 0: the offline gate must stay offline. Don't fetch from `bin/generate`.
2. The integration workflow (`.github/workflows/integration.yml`, the countries +
   pokeapi job) gets a step that runs `examples/github/generate.rb` with the
   Actions-provided token (`GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` — it can
   call the GraphQL API; check `permissions:` on the job) and then `git diff
   --exit-code -- examples/github/generated`, so drift fails CI where the network
   exists. If the Actions token can't introspect (some scopes refuse the GraphQL
   API), report that with the error and fall back to a parity spec tagged
   `integration: true` that skips without a token.
3. Regenerate the example now so the tree is current (the header line and whatever
   else moved since 0.7.4), and commit that drift together with the change.
4. Nothing under `spec/` changes for this unless you add the parity spec.

## Ownership

`bin/generate`, `examples/github/**` (not `schema.json` — gitignored), the
integration workflow, and one CHANGELOG bullet under `## Unreleased` (no Action).
Other lanes are running in `lib/graph_weaver/logging.rb`, `query_module.rb`,
`codegen/emit.rb`, `docs/logging.md` and in scratch apps — stay out. Base off
`origin/main` at 89ded3e.

## Proof

`bin/generate` twice on a box with the dump: first run writes the example files,
second says "already up to date"; without the dump (move it aside) it prints the
skip line and exits 0. `gh workflow run integration.yml --ref <your branch>` is
not available to you (branch isn't pushed); instead run the exact commands the new
step runs, locally, and paste the output. Full gate before each commit.

## Report

The rule; what `bin/generate` prints in both states, verbatim; the workflow diff;
the example's regeneration diff summary; shas.
